Sector.summary_text: DCF EV GHS 105,504k vs trading comps 135,290k and precedents 157,869k. The DCF terminal value implies an exit at 3.4x EBITDA against a 6.6x peer median: the 24% WACC (with size and company-specific premiums) drives the gap.

Valuation date.summary_text: Buying at 6.0x (15% above concluded EV) gives the sponsor a 23.5% IRR and 2.88x MOIC, below the 25% hurdle (18.2% in US$). EBITDA growth creates 78% of the gain.
